note: The root key records the consonants of the river name. Its etymology is uncertain.
summary: Pishon is the first of the four river branches named in the account of Eden. Genesis identifies it by its course around the whole land of Havilah.

senses.definition: The river branch that goes around the whole land of Havilah.

evidence.note: שֵׁם הָאֶחָד פִּישׁוֹן names the first branch, and the following clause traces its course around Havilah.
